--- this is A-B from B site Credit , to take distinct acc
select distinct acc_no from kbz_analytics.derive.cbs_vw_acc_trn_history
where trn_ref_no in (
	---- A_account debit trn_ref_no
	select distinct trn_ref_no from kbz_analytics.derive.cbs_vw_acc_trn_history where  trn_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-04-30'
	and acc_no in (select acc_no from #A_acc) and drcr_ind = 'D'
	) 
and drcr_ind = 'C'
and trn_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-04-30'   			) ---- A-B end , taking distinct acc_no
--- start find B-C from B Debit
and trn_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-04-30'
and drcr_ind = 'D'


	---- A_account debit trn_ref_no

	select distinct trn_ref_no,acc_no from kbz_analytics.derive.cbs_vw_acc_trn_history where  
	trn_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-04-30'
	and acc_no in (select acc_no from #A_acc) and drcr_ind = 'D' order by lcy_amount desc
